description: Determine merge review requirements when an automated pull request modifies core engine configuration settings.

change_context.other_context: An autonomous agent submits updates to repository execution parameters; verify whether this change is eligible for autonomous merge or requires designated code owner review.

human_notes: Single: Two-tier self-governance model classifying core engine configuration and runtime files as requiring CODEOWNERS review rather than autonomous merge (ref-modonome-001) governs review requirements.

description: Investigate why the autonomy engine remains inactive and operates in read-only mode despite configuration enabling autonomous execution.

change_context.other_context: The engine configuration specifies that autonomous operation is enabled, yet starting the runner continues to emit warnings and disallows automated changes.

human_notes: Single: Runtime check in bin/modonome.mjs requiring MODONOME_ARMED=true in the process environment before honoring autonomy_enabled (ref-modonome-003) governs engine arming.

description: Improve the automated review flow so evaluation of a generated change is not biased by context carried over from the implementation step.

change_context.other_context: The same orchestration workflow produces and evaluates a candidate change, and the team wants the review result to represent an independent assessment rather than inherit unnecessary authoring-session context.

human_notes: Single: Architecture mandating that the checker runs as a distinct invocation receiving only diff and rationale without the maker's reasoning chain (ref-modonome-006) governs checker session isolation.

description: Extend the maker/checker orchestration to handle repeated rework requests without allowing the workflow to continue indefinitely.

change_context.other_context: A team is adding repeated revision handling to the review cycle and needs the new orchestration behavior to remain bounded when a work item repeatedly fails verification.

human_notes: Single: Limit capping maker/checker rework iterations and marking persistent failures for owner triage (ref-modonome-007) governs bounding iterative review cycles.

description: Determine whether automated commits authored by a service account listed as an owner satisfy merge protection review requirements.

change_context.other_context: A background pipeline opens a pull request affecting protected repository paths using a bot credential that matches a code ownership entry.

human_notes: Single: Policy requiring a human review action for CODEOWNERS approval and prohibiting bot push identities from self-approving (ref-modonome-009) governs ownership signoff.

description: Evaluate whether retrospective findings and operational lessons can be promoted into permanent repository rules by an autonomous agent.

change_context.other_context: An agent records a new quality finding and attempts to transition the retrospective recommendation into active repository configuration.

human_notes: Single: Rule mandating that knowledge packets and lessons require explicit owner action to promote into canonical rules without autonomous self-promotion (ref-modonome-010) governs learning graduation.

description: Update repository configuration files to maintain compatibility when deprecated options are renamed or removed in the schema.

change_context.other_context: Ensure existing configuration files can be updated smoothly across schema changes without breaking active repository automation.

human_notes: Single: Schema evolution standard requiring schema version increments and cumulative migration routines in scripts/migrate-config.mjs for renamed or removed fields (ref-modonome-011) governs configuration migration.

description: Detect unengaged automated reviewers in continuous integration that approve consecutive pull requests without raising questions or requesting changes.

change_context.other_context: Verify telemetry logs across review runs to flag potential rubber-stamp review patterns where an automated reviewer provides no substantive scrutiny.

human_notes: Single: Telemetry gate failing CI when a checker approves consecutive runs without requested changes or inquiries (ref-modonome-018) governs anti-rubber-stamp review checks.

description: Rewrite historical commit author metadata while avoiding unintended changes to repository source content.

change_context.other_context: An operator needs to correct attribution across existing commits and verify that the remediation affects commit metadata rather than altering application files.

human_notes: Single: Invariant requiring commit-history remediation to remain metadata-only by reusing original tree objects and verifying tree SHAs without modifying file contents (ref-modonome-019) governs history remediation safety.

description: Reconcile rollout phase documentation when historical removal of shadow mode references contrasts with staged self-governance activation guidelines.

change_context.other_context: Clarify operational prerequisites in governance specifications to document whether shadow-mode validation represents an active requirement or a deferred milestone.

human_notes: Single: Historical documentation conflict between ADR-002 (removing shadow-mode references) and ADR-025 (defining a conditional shadow-mode activation rung for future self-application) governs reconciling rollout documentation.
